applicable_observations: CHPDT (cumulative dry fruit weight, ln(y+1) scale)
approval_note: EMPTY — E05 autumn offsets must be non-empty and approved before running. Each candidate must have: (1) systematic evidence in two-season residuals, (2) clear physiological mechanism, (3) posterior difference not solely from boundary pile-up, (4) pre-registered offset range and shrinkage rule. Maximum 3 offsets. DMC offset is forbidden under CHPDT-only contract. Candidate names must be frozen after E04, not added adaptively during fitting.
